title: U.S. Treasury Says U.S. ‘Will Win in the Digital Asset Stack’ as Clarity Act Stalls
summary: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Says U.S. ‘Will Win in the Digital Asset Stack’ as Clarity Act Stalls Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that U.S. leadership in digital assets could reinforce the dollar’s global reach even as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves regulators to fill the gap. This post U.S. Treasury Says U.S. ‘Will Win in the Digital Asset Stack’ as Clarity Act Stalls first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
